snippet.title: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP | Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Fast-paced arcade football where every match is a battle of skill, timing, and unique character abilities.

Master powerful skills, score spectacular goals, climb the leagues, and challenge your friends in exciting local multiplayer matches.
